seo.h1: Grow organically with data that works.
seo.sub: Stevin monitors your organic traffic, keyword rankings and technical SEO. signalling anomalies before your rankings drop.
seo.tech_h2: Technical foundation, content structure and landing pages
seo.tech_p: Good SEO starts with a technically healthy website. Fast load times, correct indexing, structured data and a logical site structure. On top of that we build content that matches what your target audience is searching for. not on volume, but on relevance.
seo.tech_box1_p: Core Web Vitals, crawlability, index management, canonical tags, hreflang, structured data and sitemap optimisation. The foundation that ensures search engines read and value your site correctly.
seo.tech_box2_p: Pillar pages, topic clusters and internal link structure that shows search engines where your authority lies. No standalone blog posts, but a coherent structure that builds domain authority.
seo.tech_box3_p: SEO-optimised landing pages that not only rank, but also convert. With clear propositions, strong CTAs and CRM integration for direct lead processing.
seo.intent_p: Not every keyword is equally valuable. We focus on terms with commercial intent. where people are actively looking for a solution. And we measure not just traffic, but what that traffic delivers.
seo.intent_box1_p: We segment keywords by intent: informational, comparative and transactional. Your content and pages align with where the searcher is in the decision process.
seo.intent_box2_p: Through tracking and CRM integration we measure the full funnel: from organic click to lead, from lead to client. You know exactly which pages and keywords generate revenue.
seo.intent_box3_h3: Data as the basis for decisions
seo.intent_box3_p: No monthly reports with just rankings and traffic numbers. We report on what matters: leads, pipeline value and client value per channel and per keyword.
seo.chain_h2: SEO, conversion optimisation and lead follow-up as a whole
seo.chain_p: Traffic without conversion is waste. Conversion without follow-up is missed revenue. We connect these three links so organic traffic genuinely contributes to growth.
seo.chain_box1_p: Attracting relevant visitors via search engines. The right people at the right moment to the right page.
seo.chain_box2_p: Converting visitors into leads. Page layout, forms, propositions and social proof that increase conversion.
seo.chain_box3_p: Automatically processing leads into your CRM. Scoring, segmentation and follow-up flows so sales speaks to the right leads at the right time.
seo.chain_footer: These three work as a chain with us. SEO data drives CRO priorities. CRO results feed lead follow-up. And lead quality in turn drives which keywords and pages we prioritise.
seo.faq_title: Frequently asked questions about our SEO approach
seo.faq_subtitle: How SEO works within a marketing system and what you can expect.
seo.faq1_q: Do you offer SEO as a standalone service?
seo.faq1_a: No. SEO with us is always part of a broader marketing system. Standalone SEO without connection to your landing pages, CRM and follow-up generates traffic that goes nowhere. We ensure search traffic genuinely contributes to leads and revenue.
seo.faq2_q: How long does SEO take to show results?
seo.faq2_a: Technical improvements and structural optimisations are immediately noticeable to search engines. Organic growth in rankings and traffic is typically visible within three to six months. That's why we always combine SEO with channels that deliver results in the short term, like paid media.
seo.faq3_q: How do you measure SEO results?
seo.faq3_a: We look not just at rankings and traffic, but at what that traffic delivers: leads, enquiries, clients. Through our tracking and CRM integration we see exactly which organic keywords and pages contribute to your pipeline.
seo.faq4_q: What's the difference from an SEO agency?
seo.faq4_a: An SEO agency optimises your findability, but has no grip on what happens next. We build the entire chain: from search result to landing page, from form to CRM, from lead to follow-up. That makes SEO measurable down to client level.
seo.faq5_q: Does SEO work together with your paid media approach?
seo.faq5_a: Yes. We use data from paid campaigns to determine which keywords are most valuable organically. In turn we use organic data to sharpen paid campaigns. Both channels reinforce each other.
seo.cta_title: It's not a wonder. It's Stevin.
seo.cta_desc: Organic traffic that genuinely converts, measurable to the euro. Book a call and we'll show you how SEO within your marketing system delivers more leads and clients.

geo.sub: Make your brand discoverable in AI-driven search engines. Stevin helps you optimise content and structure for LLM answers.
geo.what_p1: GEO is optimising your content and site structure so AI systems can find, understand and cite your information. Where SEO is about positions in search results, GEO is about being present in the answers AI generates.
geo.what_p2: AI search engines work differently from traditional search engines. They read your content, assess your authority and decide whether your information is trustworthy enough to cite. That requires a different approach than just ranking on keywords.
geo.what_box1_p: Display a list of links. The user clicks through and reads your page. Success = high position and high click-through rate.
geo.what_box2_p: Generate a direct answer based on multiple sources. The user reads the answer without always clicking through. Success = being cited as a trusted source.
geo.why_h2: Why GEO is needed alongside classic SEO
geo.why_p: Classic SEO remains important, but it's no longer enough. A growing share of searches is answered by AI without the user clicking through. If you're not visible there, you're missing an increasingly large portion of your potential audience.
geo.why_box1_desc: Google increasingly shows AI-generated summaries at the top of search results. Content that doesn't appear there becomes less visible, regardless of your organic position.
geo.why_box2_title: Direct answers via ChatGPT and Perplexity
geo.why_box2_desc: More people are searching via AI tools instead of Google. These tools cite sources, but only if your content is well-structured and trustworthy.
geo.why_box3_desc: Users get their answer without visiting your site. You need to be visible in the answer as a brand and source, not just in the search results below it.
geo.why_box4_desc: Most businesses are still only optimising for classic SEO. Those who invest in GEO now are building a lead that's hard to close.
geo.how_h2: How we optimise your content and site structure for AI
geo.how_p: GEO is not a trick or quick fix. It requires a structural approach to your content, technical setup and authority. We build that in five layers.
geo.how_box1_p: Content that directly answers the questions of your target audience. No vague narrative, but concrete information that AI systems can extract and cite.
geo.how_box2_p: A site structure that helps AI systems understand how your content relates. Clear hierarchy, contextual links and navigation that makes the relationship between topics explicit.
geo.how_box3_p: Technical markup that helps AI systems classify your content: FAQ schema, organisation information, product and service descriptions in a format machines can directly process.
geo.how_box4_p: In-depth content around your core topics, organised in clusters. AI systems assess not just individual pages, but your total authority on a topic. Clusters build that authority.
geo.how_box5_p: Bringing your brand name, expertise and proposition back consistently in your content. So AI systems recognise you as an authority and mention your brand in their answers.
geo.faq_subtitle: What Generative Engine Optimisation involves and how it relates to SEO.
geo.faq1_q: What's the difference between SEO and GEO?
geo.faq1_a: SEO focuses on positions in traditional search results. GEO focuses on visibility in AI-generated answers. With SEO you want to be on page 1. With GEO you want AI systems to cite your content as a source. Both are complementary and reinforce each other.
geo.faq2_q: Is GEO relevant for my business?
geo.faq2_a: If your target audience searches for information, solutions or services via Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity or other AI tools, then yes. More and more searches are answered by AI. Businesses that don't appear there are losing visibility to competitors who do.
geo.faq3_q: How quickly does GEO optimisation deliver results?
geo.faq3_a: Structural improvements like structured data and content structure are picked up by AI systems relatively quickly. Building authority through content clusters takes more time, similar to SEO. That's why we start with the technical foundation and build authority gradually.
geo.faq4_q: Does GEO replace the classic SEO approach?
geo.faq4_a: No. GEO is a complement to SEO, not a replacement. Many of the principles overlap: good content structure, authority and technical health are important for both. We address them together so you're visible on both fronts.
geo.faq5_q: How do you measure GEO results?
geo.faq5_a: We monitor whether and how your content is cited in AI answers, which pages are used as sources and how your visibility develops relative to competitors. We also measure the direct effect on traffic and leads through our tracking infrastructure.
geo.cta_title: It's not a wonder. It's Stevin.
geo.cta_desc: Staying visible in AI search experiences requires structure, not guesswork. Book a call and we'll show you how your content and site structure can be optimised.

simon_stevin.sub: 1548–1620. Flemish mathematician, engineer and advisor. And the namesake of this platform.
simon_stevin.hero_h1: Simon Stevin saw through the fog as early as 1585.
simon_stevin.portrait_alt: Portrait of Simon Stevin. line drawing based on historical portrait
simon_stevin.body_p1: Simon Stevin (1548–1620) was an engineer, mathematician and advisor to Prince Maurice. He built fortifications, sailing chariots and waterworks. He invented Dutch words for science that are still in use today. wiskunde, evenaar, middellijn. He made the complex simple without sacrificing what counts.
simon_stevin.intro_sub: At a time when Europe calculated with fractions on parchment, he wrote De Thiende. and introduced decimals. Not because it sounded better, but because it was correct.
simon_stevin.body_p2: His idea: what at first glance seems like a wonder is, on closer inspection, simply logic that hadn't yet been worked out. Gravity. Terminal velocity. Tides. All 'wonders' until someone arranges the numbers behind them.
simon_stevin.body_p3: Marketing in 2026 is where physics was in 1586. We trust dashboards that contradict each other. We call it 'magic' when something works. We accept black boxes because the complexity intimidates us.
simon_stevin.body_p4: We bear his name because we continue his work. not in polders and sailing chariots, but in marketing budgets and CRM data. Laying the benchmark where others stop at 'you can't really prove that'.
simon_stevin.closing_p: It's not a wonder. It's Stevin.
simon_stevin.closing_cta: See what you pay. See what it returns.

agency_scan.hero_sub: You're not alone. Most monthly reports are designed to make the agency look good, not to tell you the hard truth.

agency_scan.pain_p1: When your marketing agency reports that 'CPA is dropping and conversions are rising', that sounds great. But if those numbers don't match the reality in your own database or bank account, something is going wrong.
agency_scan.pain_p2: We see daily how budgets leak behind the scenes of 'successful' campaigns. The three biggest blind spots:
agency_scan.blind1_body: Do you know exactly what portion of your invoice goes to Google/Meta, and what portion disappears into the agency's pocket as 'media storage'? Often the ratio is completely off.
agency_scan.blind2_body: The algorithm is optimised for cheap clicks, not real customers. You're paying top price for bouncers and spam leads, while the agency boasts about 'lots of traffic'.
agency_scan.blind3_body: Is your agency boasting about cheap leads? Chances are they're advertising on your own brand name. people who were already looking for you. to mask failing acquisition campaigns.
agency_scan.how_p: Stevin is not a new marketing agency that wants to take over your campaigns. We are the independent radar. We connect directly with your ad accounts and run the raw data through our FactEngine. No vanity metrics, just mathematics.

multiMarket.meta_description: One Bayesian model, every market, weekly recommendations. Cross-market budget reallocation in 2–4 weeks. No annual lock-in. Built on the principle that marketing math doesn't change at borders.
multiMarket.hero_sub: Marketing math doesn't change at borders. Plug in data from one country or fifty. and get answers your CFO can defend.
multiMarket.hero_cta: Plan a demo with your data
multiMarket.hero_note: 30 minutes. Live in your dashboard. No deck.
multiMarket.problem_title: Five markets, five dashboards, one impossible question.
multiMarket.problem_body: Local teams optimize inside their own silo. Headquarters sees aggregated numbers. Nobody can show. with math, not opinion. where one euro produces the most return across markets.
multiMarket.problem_close: So the answer becomes whoever shouts loudest in the meeting.
multiMarket.solution_title: One engine. Three things that change.
multiMarket.solution_1_body: Bayesian decomposition. Per market, per channel, per week. Local signals. holidays, weather, search demand, seasonality. go in as regressors. Output is a single number for every channel, in every market, with confidence intervals.
multiMarket.solution_1_close: Not five dashboards stitched together. One model.
multiMarket.solution_2_quote: Reallocate €18,000 from BE-Wallonia Display to NL-Amsterdam Search. Detected diminishing returns at current spend. Calculated optimum within total budget.
multiMarket.solution_2_body: That's a real recommendation from a real run. No country team had to lose anything for another to gain. the model already knew the math.
multiMarket.solution_3_title: Routes to whoever owns it. however you're organized.
multiMarket.solution_3_body:
Some brands run channels through one central specialist. Others run through local agencies in every country. Most are somewhere in between. central team, local partners, freelancers, all mixed.

The engine doesn't care. Each recommendation routes to whoever owns that channel in your setup. central team, local agency, freelancer, or the CMO directly. One inbox at the top, mapped to how your org actually runs.

multiMarket.compare_close: We're not cheaper because we're worse. We're cheaper because we engineered the consultants out, not in.

multiMarket.pilot_3_body: Third market and up. Specialist routing live.

multiMarket.comp_title: When platforms make mistakes, the math notices first.
multiMarket.comp_body_1: Billing errors. Serving outages. Reporting lags. At enterprise scale, those are six-figure mistakes. and most brands never claim them, because no one is watching the numbers at the level where the numbers get made.
multiMarket.comp_body_2: Stevin reconciles spend, delivery, and reported outcomes across every platform you run. When the numbers don't add up, we build the case file. timestamps, evidence, platform admissions. and put a refund request in your hand the same week it's spotted.
multiMarket.comp_body_3: For a brand running €5M+ per year across paid channels, a single major incident has historically meant six-figure unrecovered spend. We've seen brands recover all of it. We've seen brands never look. The difference is whether anything is watching the math, every minute, in every market.
multiMarket.comp_close: This isn't an upsell. It's how the math earns its keep.
multiMarket.proof_title: See the math, not the marketing.
multiMarket.proof_intro: We're early in our journey. There's no logo strip yet. There's something better: a working dashboard, refreshed every week, with the math in the open.
multiMarket.proof_card1_body: Bayesian decomposition rebuilt every week. You watch the numbers settle as more weeks of data come in. No quarterly slide deck from a black box.
multiMarket.proof_card2_body: Each contribution and recommendation comes with a credible interval. If the model is uncertain, you see it. No false precision dressed up as authority.
multiMarket.proof_card3_title: You can run it before you buy
multiMarket.proof_card3_body: We model one of your markets as a pilot. If the output doesn't reconcile to what you already know is true, we resolve that before the pilot ends. no contract, no invoice.
multiMarket.stevin_p1_post: wrote De Thiende. the small book that gave Europe the decimal system. His point was simple: numbers should work the same way everywhere, for everyone. No special privileges for who you are, where you live, or which guild you belong to.
multiMarket.stevin_p2: That's how we think about marketing analytics.
multiMarket.stevin_p3: A campaign in Amsterdam runs on the same math as a campaign in Atlanta. A week is a week. A conversion is a conversion. The model doesn't care about the flag on the data.
multiMarket.stevin_p4: We named the company after him for a reason.
multiMarket.cta_title: Show us your markets. We'll show you the math.
multiMarket.cta_body_1: 30 minutes. Your data. Your channels. Live in the dashboard.
multiMarket.cta_body_2: No slide deck. No procurement form. No mystery.
multiMarket.cta_note: If we can't show you something useful in the first session, you don't owe us a follow-up.
multiMarket.faq_1_q: We have data in eight platforms across five countries. How long to onboard?
multiMarket.faq_1_a: First market live in two weeks. Each additional market is two weeks. We've done five-market onboardings inside a quarter.
multiMarket.faq_2_q: Our regional teams will resist losing autonomy.
multiMarket.faq_2_a: They don't lose autonomy. They lose the obligation to argue for budget without numbers. Reallocations are math, not management decisions.
multiMarket.faq_3_a: In the cloud region you choose. EU, US, AU. We deploy in your AWS region or yours. GDPR-native architecture; SOC 2 path for US enterprise on request.
multiMarket.faq_4_q: What if we already have an MMM?
multiMarket.faq_4_a: We can run alongside it for a quarter. If our numbers don't reconcile to within rounding, that's our problem, not yours.
multiMarket.faq_5_q: How is this different from a marketing dashboard?
multiMarket.faq_5_a: A dashboard shows what happened. An MMM tells you what to do next, with confidence intervals. We do both. but the second one is the point.
multiMarket.faq_6_q: Are you a tool or a service?
multiMarket.faq_6_a: Both, neither pretending to be the other. The platform does the math. People at Stevin pick up the recommendations and own the outcome with you.
